Title: Two teammates spend the LAST shared credit at once
Preconditions: Org with exactly 1 post credit; 2 members
Test Steps: 1) Member A and Member B both publish a job at the same instant
Expected Result: Exactly ONE succeeds; the other gets 402; wallet ends at 0, never negative; one job created
Notes: Org wallet race - not just one user's tabs

Title: Two teammates unlock the SAME candidate, 1 credit left
Test Steps: 1) A and B unlock the same candidate simultaneously
Expected Result: One unlock recorded, 1 credit spent; the second must NOT double-charge NOR free-serve; wallet 0

Title: Two teammates unlock DIFFERENT candidates, 1 credit left
Test Steps: 1) A unlocks X, B unlocks Y at once
Expected Result: Only one succeeds; other 402; no negative balance; no phantom unlock

Title: Owner buys a plan while member spends the last credit
Test Steps: 1) Owner completes a purchase 2) Member spends last credit at the same moment
Expected Result: Final balance = grant + purchase - spend, exactly; no lost update; ledger reconciles

Title: Two invitees accept the LAST seat simultaneously
Test Steps: 1) Both invitees accept at the same instant
Expected Result: One becomes a member; the other gets 402 NO_SEAT_AVAILABLE; cap never exceeded

Title: Invite accepted the instant owner revokes it
Test Steps: 1) Owner revokes 2) Invitee accepts at the same moment
Expected Result: Deterministic outcome (either revoked-then-fail or accepted-then-member); never a half state / orphaned seat

Title: Seat-downgrade cron races a suspended member's request
Test Steps: 1) Fire the member's request at the same time the daily cron runs
Expected Result: Request-time rank and cron-materialized status agree; no window where an over-cap member is ACTIVE and posts

Title: Delete-refund races an incoming application
Test Steps: 1) Delete the job the same instant an application lands
Expected Result: Refund decision sees a consistent applicant count; no refund if the application committed; no double-refund

Title: Unlock commits the instant the seeker deletes account
Test Steps: 1) Employer unlock and seeker account-deletion at the same moment
Expected Result: Either unlock fails cleanly OR it commits but the contact is NOT served post-deletion; spend/erasure both consistent

Title: Concurrent duplicate application (two tabs + double-submit)
Test Steps: 1) Submit the same application from two tabs at once
Expected Result: Single application row; unique constraint / idempotent guard holds

Title: Two admins approve the same pending employer
Test Steps: 1) Both approve at once
Expected Result: Single effective dual-flip; second is a no-op/idempotent; no duplicate side-effects; audit sane

Title: Two admins hard-delete the same post
Test Steps: 1) Both delete at once
Expected Result: One deletes with full cascade; other gets 404/no-op; no partial cascade / orphaned children

Title: Razorpay webhook delivered N times (retries)
Test Steps: 1) Deliver the identical webhook 5 times
Expected Result: Credits granted exactly once; 4 are idempotent no-ops; all recorded in the webhook audit log

Title: Webhook + client-verify + webhook-replay (triple path)
Test Steps: 1) Client-verify 2) Webhook 3) Replay the webhook
Expected Result: One grant total; the shared atomic claim prevents any double-grant across all three

Title: Cron overlaps its own previous (slow) run
Test Steps: 1) Force two cron runs to overlap
Expected Result: Jobs not double-expired; grace not double-applied; each transition happens once

Title: Notification fan-out retried after partial failure
Test Steps: 1) Fail mid-fan-out 2) Re-dispatch
Expected Result: No duplicate SMS/WhatsApp/push/email; idempotent per (notification, channel); in-app not duplicated

Title: Repeated activate/deactivate (post & skill)
Test Steps: 1) POST activate twice, deactivate twice
Expected Result: Idempotent; no state thrash; final state correct

Title: Re-link the same sector+title pair
Test Steps: 1) POST the same link twice
Expected Result: Upsert no-op; no duplicate edge

Title: Soft-delete a user twice
Test Steps: 1) DELETE then DELETE again
Expected Result: 2nd returns 200 'already deleted'; no double side-effects

Title: Ledger invariant holds under concurrent load
Test Steps: 1) Drive concurrent grants + spends 2) Compute sum(lots) - sum(spends) vs wallet
Expected Result: Invariant always holds; wallet == ledger sum at every observable point

Title: Balance can never go negative (no oversell)
Test Steps: 1) Hammer spends beyond balance concurrently
Expected Result: No spend drives balance < 0; excess spends 402; credits never oversold

Title: Credit debited but job insert fails -> rollback
Test Steps: 1) Publish a job where the DB insert fails after the debit
Expected Result: Transaction rolls back; no orphan spend; balance unchanged; no ghost job

Title: Spend order with equal-expiry lots + never-expiring pack
Test Steps: 1) Spend across lots with equal expiries and a pack
Expected Result: Deterministic tie-break; pack (never-expire) always consumed LAST

Title: Employer soft-delete freezes, restore returns exact state
Test Steps: 1) Soft-delete 2) Restore
Expected Result: Credits frozen (not destroyed); restore returns exact balances, lots, expiries

Title: Invoice numbers unique + monotonic under concurrency
Test Steps: 1) Fire many purchases at once across an FY boundary
Expected Result: Numbers unique, monotonic, no gaps/dupes; series resets each April with no collision

Title: GST amounts equal across checkout/invoice/admin
Test Steps: 1) Compare amount at checkout, on the invoice PDF, and in admin reconciliation
Expected Result: Identical to the paisa (e.g. 588.82) at all three; no rounding drift

Title: No controller authorizes on userId (org re-key)
Test Steps: 1) Audit that every employer-scoped query keys on employerId, not userId
Expected Result: authz edge is EmployerUser only; no userId leaks into scoping predicates

Title: Soft-revoke member preserves work, writes no txn
Test Steps: 1) Remove the member 2) Inspect jobs/unlocks/ledger 3) Re-invite
Expected Result: Jobs+unlocks remain; NO CreditTransaction written; re-invite reactivates the SAME membership row (no dup)

Title: Live job survives soft-delete of its JobTitle
Test Steps: 1) Admin soft-deletes that job title
Expected Result: Live job stays valid and visible; no orphan/FK break; only NEW posts lose the option

Title: createAndLink half-write is reconcilable
Test Steps: 1) Create a job title where the link fails 2) Retry
Expected Result: Created-but-unlinked title is discoverable and fixable via 'Link existing'; no silent 409 loop; no invisible orphan

Title: Re-unlock never writes a second spend
Test Steps: 1) Unlock the same candidate again (even concurrently)
Expected Result: Dedup holds; no second CreditTransaction; contact served free

Title: Erasure keeps the spend, stops serving PII
Test Steps: 1) Verify unlock row + served contact after erasure
Expected Result: Unlock row persists (real spend); PII never served post-erasure; no snapshot-and-serve

Title: BE down after charge, before verify
Test Steps: 1) Charge succeeds at Razorpay 2) BE is down for client-verify 3) BE recovers, webhook delivers
Expected Result: Money never taken without eventual credits; webhook reconciles; exactly one grant

Title: Webhook endpoint down at delivery time
Test Steps: 1) Razorpay delivers while endpoint is down 2) Razorpay retries later
Expected Result: System catches up idempotently once healthy; no lost or double grant

Title: Notification provider (MSG91/FCM) down
Test Steps: 1) Trigger a notifying action while providers are down
Expected Result: Core action still succeeds; delivery records SKIPPED/retry; never blocks or rolls back the action

Title: Connection pool exhaustion under load
Test Steps: 1) Drive requests beyond the DB pool size
Expected Result: Graceful 503/backpressure; no corruption; recovers when load drops; no leaked connections

Title: Rate-limit/cache store (Redis) down
Test Steps: 1) Take Redis down 2) Hit auth/OTP + cached reads
Expected Result: Define + verify: rate-limit fails CLOSED for auth/OTP (secure); cache misses degrade to DB, not error

Title: Cron misses its 03:00 window (server was down)
Test Steps: 1) Skip a scheduled run 2) Run next day
Expected Result: Catches up all missed expiries + grace transitions without double-applying

Title: Process killed mid-unlock/spend
Test Steps: 1) Kill the process during a spend+record 2) Restart
Expected Result: On restart: no partial spend, no lost unlock; transaction all-or-nothing

Title: Payment gateway timeout (no response)
Test Steps: 1) Gateway never responds to verify
Expected Result: Order stays pending; no phantom credits; user can safely retry; webhook still reconciles

Title: FE/BE contract skew
Test Steps: 1) Run a newer FE against an older BE (and vice versa)
Expected Result: FE tolerates unknown/missing fields; BE tolerant of stale client (e.g. stray audio field discarded, never 400)

Title: Reverse proxy misconfig / down
Test Steps: 1) Take the proxy down / point it at the wrong port
Expected Result: Clear failure to clients; no silent wrong-backend; recovery restores service

Title: Temp/disk full during invoice PDF generation
Test Steps: 1) Generate a PDF with no disk space
Expected Result: Error surfaced; no corrupt/partial PDF served; retry works after space frees

Title: Candidate FTS over 100k+ profiles
Test Steps: 1) Run candidate search + paginate deep
Expected Result: p95 within target; pagination stable under concurrent inserts (keyset preferred over OFFSET drift)

Title: Employer with 40+ jobs and thousands of applicants
Test Steps: 1) Load dashboard + applicant lists
Expected Result: Responsive; paginated; no N+1 blowup

Title: Polling thundering herd
Test Steps: 1) Simulate many clients polling simultaneously
Expected Result: DB/load bounded; consider backoff/interval; no meltdown (polling is the locked design - no WebSockets)

Title: 12-month revenue aggregation at scale
Test Steps: 1) Load admin dashboard trend over a big dataset
Expected Result: Aggregation indexed/bounded; dashboard loads within target

Title: Taxonomy tree with thousands of nodes
Test Steps: 1) Load /admin/taxonomy tree
Expected Result: Query + render acceptable; no full-tree hang

Title: Fan-out to many recipients
Test Steps: 1) Trigger a notification to many users
Expected Result: Batched delivery; not N blocking calls; queue-backed

Title: OTP-send storm / registration spike
Test Steps: 1) Burst OTP sends
Expected Result: Rate-limit + capacity hold; no provider-cost blowout; no meltdown

Title: Job feed pagination under concurrent posts
Test Steps: 1) Paginate the feed while jobs are being posted
Expected Result: No duplicates/skips across pages (keyset consistency); indexed filters

Title: Trial-credit farming at scale
Test Steps: 1) Re-register with varied phone/email but same GSTIN etc.
Expected Result: Dedup on verified GSTIN/phone/email holds; trial granted once per real identity

Title: Unlock-and-scrape the candidate DB
Test Steps: 1) Rapidly unlock many candidates to harvest contacts
Expected Result: Credits strictly enforced per unlock; rate-limit/abuse signals; no bulk-export bypass

Title: Post-harvest-delete free-repost abuse
Test Steps: 1) Post -> collect applicants -> delete -> repost repeatedly
Expected Result: 24h + no-applicant refund guard blocks free reposting once applicants exist

Title: Distributed OTP brute-force
Test Steps: 1) Brute-force OTPs across many numbers
Expected Result: Per-identity AND per-IP throttling; no global bypass

Title: Webhook forgery flood
Test Steps: 1) Flood /webhooks/razorpay with bad signatures
Expected Result: Cheap constant-time reject; no DB writes; no DoS amplification

Title: IDOR sweep across enumerated ids
Test Steps: 1) Iterate ids across invoices/candidates/jobs/conversations as another org
Expected Result: All 403; ids are non-guessable (UUID); no cross-org read

Title: Token replay after logout
Test Steps: 1) Logout 2) Reuse the old JWT before expiry
Expected Result: Document + decide: JWT is stateless (logout is client-side) - assess short TTL / rotation / denylist need; flag if a stolen token stays valid post-logout
Notes: Architect flag - server-side invalidation not present

Title: Timing-based account enumeration
Test Steps: 1) Time login/forgot responses for known vs unknown accounts
Expected Result: Constant-time / indistinguishable responses; no timing oracle

Title: Mass-assignment sweep across strict bodies
Test Steps: 1) Send role/isAdmin/amount/employerId etc. to every write endpoint
Expected Result: Strict schemas reject or ignore; no privilege escalation / price override

Title: Rate-limit bypass via spoofed headers
Test Steps: 1) Rotate X-Forwarded-For to dodge throttling
Expected Result: Real client identity throttled; trust only the proxy-set client IP

Title: Seeker erasure converges across ALL surfaces
Test Steps: 1) Delete account 2) Check feed, employer unlocked record, admin monetization, chat
Expected Result: All converge: contact gone everywhere, spend still recorded, chats handled; no surface still serving PII

Title: Employer soft-delete propagates + reverses
Test Steps: 1) Admin soft-deletes 2) Seeker feed + in-flight applications 3) Restore
Expected Result: Live jobs stop surfacing; applications handled sanely; restore reverses cleanly

Title: Language preference cross-device
Test Steps: 1) Set Hindi on web 2) Open another device/surface
Expected Result: Define + verify: is language server-persisted (syncs) or client-only? Behavior must be intentional, not accidental

Title: Multi-channel partial failure independence
Test Steps: 1) Schedule interview with one channel (e.g. email) failing
Expected Result: Other channels (in-app, WhatsApp) still fire; no all-or-nothing; failure logged/retried

Title: Read-your-writes across surfaces
Test Steps: 1) Write on one surface 2) Immediately read on another
Expected Result: Reflected immediately OR a documented, bounded eventual-consistency window that never misleads a moderation/money decision

Title: Attribution vs authorization after removal
Test Steps: 1) Remove a member 2) Check their created jobs/unlocks vs their access
Expected Result: Attribution persists (createdByUserId), authorization revoked (no employer access) - both hold simultaneously

Title: 30-day job window in IST regardless of server TZ
Test Steps: 1) Post a job 2) Verify expiry date
Expected Result: Expires on the correct IST calendar day; DST/TZ-safe; not off-by-one from UTC

Title: Day-3 grace boundary vs cron timing
Test Steps: 1) Fire a request at 23:59:59 the same day the day-3 cron runs
Expected Result: Deterministic: exactly one of grace-active vs inactivated applies; no double transition

Title: Credit lot expiry exactly at spend instant
Test Steps: 1) Spend at the exact expiry timestamp
Expected Result: Inclusive/exclusive rule defined and consistent between the gate and the cron

Title: OTP/token expiry under clock skew
Test Steps: 1) Issue on server A, validate on server B with skew
Expected Result: No accept/reject beyond the allowed tolerance; consistent expiry across nodes

Title: FY reset exactly at Apr 1 00:00 IST
Test Steps: 1) Purchase just before and just after Apr 1 00:00 IST
Expected Result: Series resets cleanly; no cross-FY number collision; correct YY-YY prefix

Title: Chargeback keeps credits (revenue leak)
Test Steps: 1) Dispute/chargeback a Razorpay payment 2) Check credits
Expected Result: Currently credits are NOT revoked on chargeback - documents the known revenue-leak risk (v1.1 chargeback-revocation)
Notes: Known v1.1 gap - flag, do not expect a pass

Title: No admin manual credit grant/revoke
Test Steps: 1) Simulate a paid-but-uncredited state 2) Look for a support remedy
Expected Result: No admin tool to fix it (v1.1) - a failed webhook leaves support with no manual recovery path

Title: JWT in localStorage (XSS token theft blast radius)
Test Steps: 1) Assess token storage + XSS surface
